newsitem.title: ISRAEL: MACCABI TEL AVIV TAKES ISRAEL BASKETBALL CROWN.
newsitem.headline: MACCABI TEL AVIV TAKES ISRAEL BASKETBALL CROWN.

text.p: Maccabi Tel Aviv won Israel's basketball league championship for the 37th time on Wednesday, sweeping the best-of-five final play-offs 3-0 with an 86-83 victory over Hapoel Jerusalem in the third game.
It was the fourth consecutive league title for Maccabi, who have won it 27 times in the last 28 seasons. In all, they have won 37 of 43 league campaigns.

Their last loss was in the 1992-93 season when they were beaten in the final play-offs by Hapoel Galil Elyon. Both Maccabi Tel Aviv and State Cup holders Hapoel Jerusalem qualify for next season's EuroLeague.
